title: Two subnets glued at a port
text: One subnet with an input port `IN`, an internal place `mid` and an output port `OUT` is instantiated twice, as `a` and `b`, and composed so the `OUT` of `a` and the `IN` of `b` are the same place, `handoff`. Composition renames each instance's places and transitions with its prefix and leaves a flat net, so the Lean reference replays it like any other net and the diagram groups each instance in a cluster.

steps.text: The `IN` port of `a` is bound to `source`. The transition `a/run` moves the token into the own place `a/mid` of `a`.
The `OUT` port of `a` is `handoff`, which is also the `IN` port of `b`.
The place `b/mid` is a different place from `a/mid`: each instance keeps its own state.
The `OUT` port of `b` is bound to `sink`. The run ends there. The verifier reads the composed net as a flat net too: deadlock free with `sink` as the only sink place is `Proven`.
